newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi interior minister receives Yemen's Iryani.
newsitem.headline: Saudi interior minister receives Yemen's Iryani.

text.p: Saudi Arabian and Yemeni ministers met on Tuesday to discuss efforts to settle their 60-year-old border dispute, the official Saudi news agency SPA reported.

Saudi Arabia's Interior Minister Prince Nayef bin Abdul-Aziz received Yemen's Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Abdul-Karim al-Iryani shortly after he arrived in the Saudi capital Riyadh earlier in the day, it added.
SPA gave no further details on Iryani's second visit to Saudi Arabia in three weeks.
Yemen and Saudi Arabia had several minor clashes in a border area potentially rich in oil and gas before the two sides signed a memorandum of understanding last year to resolve the row.
A landmark visit to Yemen by Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan in August appeared to put an end to years of tension and mistrust between the neighbouring countries.
